paragraphs: I'm applying for the Manager, Finance role on the Engineering Finance team in Operations & Technology at NBCUniversal. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role interests me because Engineering Finance consolidates OCF, capital, headcount and allocations across several lines of business, so the numbers feed planning for the whole company.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, managed cash flow analysis over 80%+ of inflows, and handled reconciliation with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting.

That maps to the budget, quarterly forecasts, monthly close and executive reporting on your team. I have SAP experience and strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, and I like making a reporting process simpler once I understand it. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the Manager, Finance role on NBCU's Engineering Finance team. At Lenovo I built forecasts and variance analyses on budget reallocation, and at Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting and close. I'd love to hear how the team runs the close and forecast. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
